bundles.title: Bootstrap Local App Shell
bundles.goal: Create the baseline FastAPI and React/Vite application shell, local-only dev wiring, and repo hygiene needed for all later work.

tasks.title: Scaffold the FastAPI app with localhost binding, CORS policy, and placeholder route registration
Scaffold the React + Vite TypeScript client entrypoint and shared API bootstrap
Add local development startup wiring for server and client
Ignore runtime project artifacts and other generated local state in git

bundles.title: Set Up Fixtures And Test Harness
bundles.goal: Establish reusable fixtures and automated test harnesses for backend integration, renderer golden tests, and browser E2E flows.

tasks.title: Create fixture source PNGs, mask samples, and output-setting samples for repeatable tests
Create a mock Claude CLI script that can emit success and failure variants for both LLM stages
Configure backend integration, renderer golden, and browser E2E test runners around the shared fixtures

bundles.title: Implement Project Store Core
bundles.goal: Provide the filesystem-backed project layout, draft-slot helpers, mask presence utilities, and static asset serving contract.

tasks.title: Implement project directory creation and v3 project.json read/write helpers
Implement active-draft storage helpers, plan-token checks, and draft cleanup primitives
Implement shared content-based mask presence utilities for missing-mask and labels-present checks
Implement read-only static asset handlers and startup cleanup for stale staging and backup directories

bundles.title: Build Image Input Intake
bundles.goal: Accept project creation uploads, validate output settings, convert supported PNG modes to RGBA, and persist the initial source plus body mask.

tasks.title: Implement multipart POST /projects parsing and output-setting validation
Implement PNG mode acceptance, RGBA conversion, and unsupported-mode rejection
Persist source.png and auto-initialize body.png according to alpha and conversion rules
Add integration coverage for valid uploads, invalid files, size limits, and range validation

bundles.title: Implement Mask Annotation Flow
bundles.goal: Enable four-label mask editing with server-side cleanup filters, immediate persistence, and browser-based annotation UX.
inputs: design.md#Mask 永続化フォーマット

tasks.title: Implement POST /projects/{id}/masks/{label} with mode and dimension validation plus per-label filter behavior
Build the canvas editor with pen, eraser, bucket fill, zoom, undo, and label switching across body, tail, mouth, and fin
Reload server-filtered masks into the canvas after debounced saves and expose derived-body and save-status feedback
Add browser E2E coverage for four-label annotation and filter round-trips

bundles.title: Implement LLM Plan Draft Flow
bundles.goal: Run the first LLM call, normalize and validate the plan, persist the active plan draft, and support params editing with stale-config invalidation.

tasks.title: Implement the Claude subprocess wrapper with JSON extraction, timeout handling, and auth or exit-code error mapping
Validate and normalize llm-plan responses including single-animation enforcement, param defaults, and unsupported PoC type gating
Persist the active plan draft, compute missing_masks from content-based mask checks, and support PATCH params updates with renderer-config invalidation
Add integration tests for valid plans, invalid plans, missing masks, and draft persistence behavior

bundles.title: Build Renderer Core And Swim Template
bundles.goal: Create the in-process renderer package, shared export pipeline, and deterministic swim_slow template implementation.

tasks.title: Create the renderer core, template interface, and common GIF or spritesheet export helpers
Implement fish_swim_slow_v1 with deterministic frame generation and args handling
Add golden tests for swim_slow output stability and shared export behavior

bundles.title: Add Eat Template Support
bundles.goal: Extend the renderer with the eat template so the PoC supports the second required animation type.

tasks.title: Implement fish_eat_v1 on the shared renderer core
Register both supported templates and enforce deterministic template lookup
Add golden coverage for eat output, mask interactions, and loop-sensitive export behavior

bundles.title: Implement Renderer Config Draft Flow
bundles.goal: Run the second LLM call, validate template and args compatibility, persist renderer-config drafts, and expose args editing.

tasks.title: Implement POST /projects/{id}/renderer-config using the active plan draft and template compatibility checks
Persist renderer_config.json with server-derived loop, plan_token, and created_at metadata
Implement PATCH /projects/{id}/active-draft/renderer-config with args-only edit rules and forbidden-key rejection
Add integration tests and UI support for valid configs, out-of-range args, and stale-draft rejection

bundles.title: Implement Animation Commit And Re-Render
bundles.goal: Render from active drafts, atomically commit outputs and v3 animation entries, and support seed-from plus in-place re-render semantics.
inputs: design.md#In-place re-render の永続化戦略

tasks.title: Implement POST /projects/{id}/animations with draft completeness checks, plan-token validation, and required-mask revalidation
Stage renderer outputs under animations/.tmp and atomically commit animation directories plus project.json updates
Implement seed-from and POST /projects/{id}/animations/{animation_id}/re-render with backup-and-replace rollback
Return hydrated v3 animation responses and clear active drafts only after successful commit

bundles.title: Build Project Library Management
bundles.goal: Support listing, reopening, duplicating, deleting, and hydrating persisted projects and animations from the filesystem store.

tasks.title: Implement GET /projects and GET /projects/{id} with thumbnail summaries, inline renderer_config hydration, and static URLs
Implement duplicate and delete endpoints with empty-animation duplicate semantics and project cleanup
Build the project library UI for reopen, duplicate, and delete actions
Add persistence coverage for reload after restart and duplicate-save constraints

bundles.title: Wire Input To Annotation Screens
bundles.goal: Connect the input, params, and annotation screens to the backend contracts through the first half of the generation lifecycle.
inputs: design.md#Generate flow alignment with local-app-shell spec

tasks.title: Connect the Input screen to project creation and output-setting validation responses
Connect the Params screen to llm-plan responses, params PATCH updates, and draft resume behavior
Connect the Annotation screen to required and optional regions, skip-friendly mask flow, and renderer-config handoff
Add E2E coverage for the upload-to-annotation path including missing-mask prompts

bundles.title: Wire Result Flow And Regeneration
bundles.goal: Connect the result screen and animation history UX to renderer-config drafts, rendering, re-rendering, add-another-animation, and reopen flows.

tasks.title: Build the Result screen around renderer-config drafts, args editing, and render submission
Implement Add another animation and seed-from-based Re-generate transitions
Hydrate reopened projects into result or draft states using library data and active_draft metadata
Add end-to-end coverage for two animations, in-place re-render, and project reopen

bundles.title: Implement Failure Recovery And UX Polish
bundles.goal: Make LLM and render failures recoverable without corrupting project state while polishing save, resume, and retry behavior.
inputs: design.md#失敗種別 → HTTP エラー対応

tasks.title: Surface retriable versus non-retriable LLM and renderer errors while preserving prompt and output inputs for retry
Implement explicit Save feedback, draft resume on reload, and abandon-draft clearing behavior
Verify that all mapped failure modes leave project files, drafts, and committed animations uncorrupted
Add integration and E2E regression coverage for failure scenarios and recovery after server restart
